about.fork: VoiceStudio VozIA for Android, based on VoiceStudio by Palash Debnath and contributors (AGPL-3.0). Source: github.com/Fakesss/VozIAApk.

speak.title: Title (optional)
speak.system_hint: Uses the speech engine installed on this phone. For VoiceStudio AI voices, pick a model such as Piper, Supertonic or Kokoro.
speak.background_hint: You can leave this screen or close the app; the task continues in the background and appears in Tasks.
speak.clone_slow: Cloned voices run the large OmniVoice model on the phone: expect seconds to minutes per sentence. Progress shows while it works, and other voices keep working meanwhile.

project.name: Project name
project.busy: Cancel or finish this project's running tasks first.
project.empty: Nothing saved in this project yet.
project.delete_body: This permanently deletes {{count}} files ({{size}}) stored inside the app for this project. Copies you exported ({{exports}}) to Downloads or other folders are NOT deleted.

item.subtitle: Subtitles
item.delete_body: The copy inside the app is deleted. Exported copies ({{exports}}) stay where you saved them.

export.title: Save a copy
export.failed: The file could not be saved. Try another location.
export.no_space: Not enough free space for this file. Free up space and try again.
export.missing: The app's copy of this file is missing or damaged.
export.folder_unavailable: The export folder is no longer accessible. Choose it again in Settings.
export.name_exhausted: Too many files with this name in the folder.
export.no_viewer: No installed app can open this file.

storage.verify_failed: Verification failed: the saved file does not match the original. Nothing was reported as saved.

library.title: Projects
library.card: Your saved audio, books and transcripts
library.empty: No projects yet. Generate speech or create a project.
library.where: Projects and files stay on this phone after closing the app or restarting. To use a file in other apps, open it and choose Save to Downloads, Save to folder or Save as.

task.title: Tasks
task.hint: Long jobs run in the background with a notification. Interrupted tasks resume automatically.
task.voice_missing: The selected cloned voice was deleted.
task.empty_text: There is no text to read.
task.still_running: Cancel the task before deleting it.
task.waiting_engine: Waiting for another task to free the model
task.result_deleted: The result of this task was deleted.
task.too_many_attempts: This task was interrupted too many times (the app closed or Android stopped it). Try a smaller text or another model, and allow background use in Settings.
task.paused_by_android: Paused by Android's time limit; open the app to continue

audiobook.title: Audiobooks
audiobook.card: Turn books and long texts into chapters of audio
audiobook.intro: Import a .txt, .md or .epub file (or paste text). Chapters are detected from headings such as “Chapter 1”, and each chapter becomes an audio file.
audiobook.name: Audiobook name
audiobook.no_chapters: No chapters yet. Import or paste a text.
audiobook.merge: Also create one file with the whole book
audiobook.too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB.
audiobook.unreadable: This file could not be read as text or EPUB.
audiobook.chapters_generated: Some chapters already have audio. Discard them before replacing the text.
audiobook.mixed_rates: Chapters were generated with different voices; regenerate them with one voice.

transcribe.title: Transcribe
transcribe.card: Audio and video to text and subtitles
transcribe.intro: Transcribes on this phone with Whisper. You get the text and SRT/VTT subtitles with timestamps.

settings.private_note: App files are private and kept across restarts and updates. Uninstalling the app deletes them; exported copies remain.

dictate.english_only: The streaming English model shows words as you speak. For Portuguese and other languages choose Whisper: each phrase appears after a short pause.

dub.duplicate: This file is already being dubbed. Follow it below, or remove that job first to start again.

battery.hint: Android is limiting this app's battery use, so long tasks may pause while the screen is off. Allow it to run in the background for reliable generation, cloning and dubbing.
battery.restricted: Battery: restricted by Android (long tasks may pause)

performance.title: Performance and background
performance.copied: Report copied. It lists your device, models and recent tasks, without texts or audio.
performance.fast_clone_hint: Cloned voices and dubbing decode in 16 steps instead of 32: about twice as fast, with a voice slightly less faithful to the sample.

local.system_tts_unavailable: No speech engine is installed on this phone. Install one (for example Speech Services by Google) or download a VoiceStudio model.
local.system_tts_language: The phone's speech engine has no voice for this language. Pick another language or a VoiceStudio model.
local.system_tts_timeout: The phone's speech engine stopped responding. Open the app again and retry; if it keeps happening, update or switch the speech engine in Android settings, or pick a VoiceStudio model.

android.stage_waiting: Waiting for another task to finish
